items.q: When will my vehicles appear in MyGeotab?
items.a: Vehicles normally appear within a few minutes of the device being plugged in and the ignition being turned on.

items.q: How do I add another user?
items.a: Go to People, then Users and Drivers, and choose Add. Assign a security clearance that matches the person's role.

items.q: Who do I contact for support?
items.a: Contact your account team. Their details are in your onboarding guide.
